description.zh: 自定义属性ID，需匹配 `^custom-attribute:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,98}$`，custom-attribute: 后面的部分长度小于100
description.en: The custom attribute ID. The ID must match the regular expression `^custom-attribute:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,98}$`. The part after 'custom-attribute:' must be less than 100 characters long.
